description: Read one inbound email by id; read its attachments with getEmailAttachment. By default body_text leaves out quoted history and shows each link as an [n] marker; the links argument returns their targets. When body_next_offset is not null, call again with offset set to it. If parse_status is pending or processing, read it again shortly; failed means the body may be incomplete. full: true returns the stored record instead. Result: id, thread_id, received_at, from, to, subject, body_text, attachments, and parse_status when known; by default also preheader, body_source, body_chars, body_offset, body_next_offset, body_incomplete, quoted_chars_removed, image_count, link_count, and links when asked for; with full: status, from_email, to_email, body_html, parsed, auth and replies.

api_key.description: API key from createEmailAddress, used in place of sign-in.

full.description: Return the stored record, with the HTML body, links, quoted history and authentication results, instead of the compact view for reading.

id.description: Inbound email ID from listEmails or searchEmails.

links.description: Link targets to include in `links`: all of them, or the [n] numbers you want. Leave it out for none. Not used with full.

max_chars.description: How much of body_text to return per call; read the rest with offset. Not used with full.

offset.description: Character position in the body to start from: the body_next_offset of the previous result. Not used with full.

name: getEmail

attachments.description: Files on the email; read one with getEmailAttachment.

filename.description: File name; null when the email gave none.

part_index.description: Pass to getEmailAttachment to read it.

auth.description: full only: SPF, DKIM and DMARC results; their keys vary by message.

body_chars.description: Length of the whole body, in characters. Not with full.

body_incomplete.description: True when the HTML was too deep to read in full. Not with full.

body_next_offset.description: Pass as offset to read on; null at the end. Not with full.

body_offset.description: Where this part of the body starts. Not with full.

body_source.description: html, text or none: what body_text was made from. Not with full.

body_text.description: The body as text. Quoted history is left out and links are [n] markers, unless full. Null when there is none.

from.description: Sender, as the From header shows it.

image_count.description: Images in the body. Not with full.

link_count.description: Links in the body. Not with full.

links.description: With the links argument: the link targets asked for.

parse_status.description: Parse stage, when known. pending or processing: read again shortly; failed: the body may be incomplete.

parsed.description: full only: the parsed message as stored; its keys vary by message.

preheader.description: Inbox preview text. Not with full.

quoted_chars_removed.description: Characters of quoted history left out. Not with full.

replies.description: full only: replies you sent to it.

thread_id.description: Conversation id, for getConversation; null when it is in none.

title: Get email
